question: Which additional powers complete the enumeration begun in the previous verse?
premises: More powers are listed in continuation.
The names or epithets include all-maddening and all-delighting.
They also include with-breaking and fully-rousing.
inference: The continued enumeration includes Sarvonmādā, Sarvasukhā, Sabhaṅgā, and Abhitodyamā.
uncertainties: Whether these are proper names or descriptive epithets is not fully certain.
